definitions.explanation: The category of traditional Japanese clothing, including kimono, yukata, hakama, and related garments, as opposed to Western-style clothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和装|わそう}にした。
examples.english: I chose Japanese-style dress for the wedding.

examples.japanese: {和装|わそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧⟦{髪型|かみがた}→髪型：14646_kamigata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose a hairstyle that suits Japanese-style clothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{和装|わそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more young people are wearing traditional Japanese dress at the coming-of-age ceremony.

notes:
A compound of {和|わ} (Japanese) and {装|そう} (clothing, attire). Functions as the umbrella term for all traditional Japanese garments. Commonly contrasted with {洋装|ようそう} (Western-style clothing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和装|わそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend in Japanese dress
- {和装|わそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花嫁|はなよめ}→花嫁：04318_hanayome⟧: a bride in Japanese dress
- {和装|わそう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{洋装|ようそう}: Japanese and Western clothing
- {和装|わそう}⟦{小物|こもの}→小物：17814_komono⟧: Japanese clothing accessories

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧: kimono — the most representative garment within {和装|わそう}; sometimes used loosely as a synonym
- {洋装|ようそう}: Western-style clothing — the direct counterpart
- ⟦{装束|しょうぞく}→装束：14048_shouzoku⟧: traditional costume — a more formal or historical term for ceremonial attire
